create_CachedBackends: create a CachedBackends object to manage multiple LLM backends with shared and per-user cache directories
load_backend_cache: load cached results for a specific backend from shared, own, and additional cache directories
save_caches: save all managed backend caches that use SimpleFunctionCache to disk
subtract_cache_data: diff current backend caches against original cache data to isolate newly added entries
print_cache_summary: print a summary of cache sizes, counters, and in-progress calls for all managed backends
